ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَنْعِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِتَجَلِّي الْأَسْمَاءِ وَالصِّفَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa an`im `alaynā bi ‘t-tajallī ‘l-Asmā’i wa ‘ṣ-Ṣifāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and favor us with revealed names and attributes!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَغْرِقْنَا فِيْ عَيْنِ بَحْرِ الْوَحْدَةِ السَّارِيَةِ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْمَوْجُوْدَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa aghriqnā fī `ayni baḥri ‘l-waḥdati ‘s-sāriyati fī jamī`i ‘l-mawjūdāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and drown us in the essential sea of penetrating Unity in all that exists!
